control.description: Existing King and Sanders remain in Democratic caucus; all four modeled independent opposition contenders unassigned, matching stated campaign pledges without treating pledges as certain future conduct.

limitations: Unchanged fundamentals reference: Fundamentals-only forecast; no current polling or candidate-quality term.
Unchanged fundamentals reference: Binary matchup/effective-share proxies; no full election-rule or all-candidate simulation.
Unchanged fundamentals reference: No participation or vote-count forecast.
Unchanged fundamentals reference: Predictive Monte Carlo error is conditional on saved posterior draws; resampling does not increase posterior ESS.
Unchanged fundamentals reference: Saved posterior diagnostics passed; protected 2022 predictions remain unscored.
Superseded polling edition: initial rerun: A computational forecast comparison; no demonstrated forecast improvement
Superseded polling edition: community identification: Not estimated in this baseline; no causal subgroup or composition attribution from toplines
Superseded polling edition: current scope: Audited source subset with visible uncovered races, not an exhaustive polling census
Superseded polling edition: public comparators: Descriptive only; no tuning to public win probabilities
Existing principal-pair aggregate approximation and omitted-option/rule qualifications retained.
Historical conditional calibration and structural priors reused without retraining or covariance uncertainty integration.
No F outputs redrawn; each alternative FP is an independently selected fundamentals/polling combination.
Source admission belongs to the separately pinned root review, not this execution adapter.
Historical calibration retains its original training plan and cutoff. This refresh changes only current polling observations; it is not recalibration.

All35 contests audited;131 qualified observations are a bounded primary-source subset, not every public polling release. Discovery-only and access/measurement holds remain in candidate/source catalogs.
Public primary evidence is chiefly preserved web-rendered content. Original primary HTML/PDF bytes generally unavailable; raw derivative CSV bytes have separate immutable Git provenance.
Exact posting dates remain unknown for22 selected observations; conservative availability bounds are preserved rather than fabricated release dates.
Historic conditional poll-error calibration reused, including parameter-uncertainty and mixed-universe approximations. This update is not retraining or empirical validation.
